title: Appliances
description: The washing machine and iron a chart is drawn for. Every label here is copied from the fascia in front of you, in whatever language it is printed in — the tool never translates them, because the point is that the drawing matches the machine.

name.description: Make and model, printed under the heading.

capacity.description: Drum capacity as the manual states it, for example "1–8 kg".

programs.description: Dial positions in physical order, starting at twelve o'clock and running clockwise. The first is the off position, and the order sets the angle each one is drawn at, so a wrong order draws a pointer aimed at the wrong programme.

temperatures.description: Temperatures the display steps through, in order. Numeric values get a degree sign when drawn; anything else, such as "cold", is printed as it stands.

spins.description: Spin speeds the display steps through, in order.

options.description: The option buttons, labelled as they are on the fascia.

settings.description: Thermostat positions in order, coolest first. The ring is drawn from the first to the last, and the steam band is drawn across the run of positions marked steam.

key.description: What the CSV's iron_setting column writes to select this. "none" is reserved for do not iron.

dots.description: The dot markings, if the dial uses them.

label.description: What is printed at this position on the ring.

detail.description: What it is for, in words: the fabrics and the temperature.

steam.description: Whether the iron makes steam here.
